confidence_notes: [Numbeo](https://www.numbeo.com/cost-of-living/in/Jaipur) and [Expatistan](https://www.expatistan.com/cost-of-living/jaipur-india) provide crowdsourced 2026 price guides; Expatistan's sample is sparse. Cocktail and wine estimates are roughly twice the beer price and vary widely by venue. July accommodation prices are less certain model estimates.
comparable_city_reasoning: Jaipur food prices are informed by local data; accommodation estimates use a general North Indian tourist-city baseline adjusted for July's monsoon season.
